title: Can you solve the prisoner boxes riddle? - Yossi Elran
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】你能解開囚犯箱之謎嗎？ ——尤西·埃爾蘭（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Your favorite band is great at playing music, but not so great at being organized.
cues.en: Your favorite band is great at playing music, but not so great at being organized.
cues.zh: 你最喜愛的樂隊演奏的時候很出色， 但並不怎麼擅長組織與編排工作。 他們老是在巡演的時候放錯樂器，

cues.text: They keep misplacing their instruments on tour, and it's driving their manager mad.
cues.en: They keep misplacing their instruments on tour, and it's driving their manager mad.
cues.zh: 但並不怎麼擅長組織與編排工作。 他們老是在巡演的時候放錯樂器， 這讓他們的經理十分惱火。

cues.text: On the day of the big concert, the band wakes up to find themselves tied up
cues.en: On the day of the big concert, the band wakes up to find themselves tied up
cues.zh: 這讓他們的經理十分惱火。 就在一場大型音樂會的當天， 這個樂隊醒來發現他們被綁在

cues.text: in a windowless, soundproof practice room.
cues.en: in a windowless, soundproof practice room.
cues.zh: 這個樂隊醒來發現他們被綁在 一個沒有窗戶並且隔音的練習室。

cues.text: Their manager explains what's happening.
cues.en: Their manager explains what's happening.
cues.zh: 一個沒有窗戶並且隔音的練習室。 他們的經理解釋了這是怎麼回事。

cues.text: Outside, there are ten large boxes.
cues.en: Outside, there are ten large boxes.
cues.zh: 他們的經理解釋了這是怎麼回事。 在外面，一共有十個大盒子。

cues.text: Each contains one of your instruments, but don't be fooled by the pictures - they've been randomly placed.
cues.en: Each contains one of your instruments, but don't be fooled by the pictures - they've been randomly placed.
cues.zh: 在外面，一共有十個大盒子。 每一個裝著一件你們的樂器， 但別被上面的圖片迷惑了， 他們都是隨機放置的。

cues.text: I'm going to let you out one at a time.
cues.en: I'm going to let you out one at a time.
cues.zh: 但別被上面的圖片迷惑了， 他們都是隨機放置的。 每次我會讓你們其中的一人出去。

cues.text: While you're outside, you can look inside any five boxes before security takes you back to the tour bus.
cues.en: While you're outside, you can look inside any five boxes before security takes you back to the tour bus.
cues.zh: 每次我會讓你們其中的一人出去。 這時候你們可以檢視任意五個盒子。 然後保安會把你們帶回巴士。

cues.text: You can't touch the instruments or in any way communicate what you find to the others.
cues.en: You can't touch the instruments or in any way communicate what you find to the others.
cues.zh: 然後保安會把你們帶回巴士。 你們不能觸碰樂器， 也不能以任何形式 同他人交流你發現了什麼。

cues.text: No marking the boxes, shouting, nothing.
cues.en: No marking the boxes, shouting, nothing.
cues.zh: 也不能以任何形式 同他人交流你發現了什麼。 不能在盒子上做記號， 不能喊叫，什麼都不能。

cues.text: If each one of you can find your own instrument, then you can play tonight.
cues.en: If each one of you can find your own instrument, then you can play tonight.
cues.zh: 不能在盒子上做記號， 不能喊叫，什麼都不能。 如果你們每人都能找對你們的樂器， 你們今晚就能演出。

cues.text: Otherwise, the label is dropping you.
cues.en: Otherwise, the label is dropping you.
cues.zh: 你們今晚就能演出。 否則演出將被取消。

cues.text: You have three minutes to think about it before we start.
cues.en: You have three minutes to think about it before we start.
cues.zh: 否則演出將被取消。 你們有三分鐘的思考時間， 然後我們就開始。

cues.text: The band is in despair.
cues.en: The band is in despair.
cues.zh: 你們有三分鐘的思考時間， 然後我們就開始。 整個樂團都十分絕望。

cues.text: After all, each musician only has a 50% chance of finding their instrument
cues.en: After all, each musician only has a 50% chance of finding their instrument
cues.zh: 整個樂團都十分絕望。 畢竟，如果只是隨機看五個盒子，

cues.text: by picking five random boxes.
cues.en: by picking five random boxes.
cues.zh: 畢竟，如果只是隨機看五個盒子， 每個人只有 50% 的機會 找到自己的樂器。

cues.text: And the chances that all ten will succeed are even lower - just 1 in 1024.
cues.en: And the chances that all ten will succeed are even lower - just 1 in 1024.
cues.zh: 每個人只有 50% 的機會 找到自己的樂器。 十個人都找對的機率就更低了—— 只有 1024 分之 1。

cues.text: But suddenly, the drummer comes up with a valid strategy that has a better than 35% chance of working.
cues.en: But suddenly, the drummer comes up with a valid strategy that has a better than 35% chance of working.
cues.zh: 只有 1024 分之 1。 但是突然， 鼓手想出了一個有效的策略， 有大於 35% 的機率能成功。

cues.text: Can you figure out what it was?
cues.en: Can you figure out what it was?
cues.zh: 有大於 35% 的機率能成功。 你能想出來這個策略是什麼嗎？

cues.text: Pause the video on the next screen if you want to figure it out for yourself!
cues.en: Pause the video on the next screen if you want to figure it out for yourself!
cues.zh: 你能想出來這個策略是什麼嗎？ 如果你想自行思考該策略的話， 請在下一畫面按暫停！

cues.text: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.en: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.zh: 3 2 1 鼓手是這麼說的：

cues.text: Here's what the drummer said: Everyone first open the box with the picture of your instrument.
cues.en: Here's what the drummer said: Everyone first open the box with the picture of your instrument.
cues.zh: 1 鼓手是這麼說的： 每人首先開啟 有自己樂器圖片的盒子。

cues.text: If your instrument is inside, you're done.
cues.en: If your instrument is inside, you're done.
cues.zh: 如果裡面就是你們的樂器， 那就完成了。 如果不是，就看看裡面是什麼，

cues.text: Otherwise, look at whatever's in there, and then open the box with that picture on it.
cues.en: Otherwise, look at whatever's in there, and then open the box with that picture on it.
cues.zh: 如果不是，就看看裡面是什麼， 再開啟有該樂器圖片的盒子。 以此類推，直到找到你們各自的樂器。

cues.text: Keep going that way until you find your instrument.
cues.en: Keep going that way until you find your instrument.
cues.zh: 以此類推，直到找到你們各自的樂器。 其他樂隊成員們都表示懷疑，

cues.text: The bandmates are skeptical, but amazingly enough, they all find what they need.
cues.en: The bandmates are skeptical, but amazingly enough, they all find what they need.
cues.zh: 以此類推，直到找到你們各自的樂器。 其他樂隊成員們都表示懷疑， 但令人驚奇的是， 他們最終都找到了各自的樂器。

cues.text: And a few hours later, they're playing to thousands of adoring fans.
cues.en: And a few hours later, they're playing to thousands of adoring fans.
cues.zh: 但令人驚奇的是， 他們最終都找到了各自的樂器。 幾小時後，他們為成千上萬 喜愛他們的粉絲帶來了精彩演出。

cues.text: So why did the drummer's strategy work?
cues.en: So why did the drummer's strategy work?
cues.zh: 為什麼鼓手的策略能得以成功呢？ 每個樂手的選擇 都是一個相聯結的序列，

cues.text: Each musician follows a linked sequence that starts with the box whose outside matches their instrument
cues.en: Each musician follows a linked sequence that starts with the box whose outside matches their instrument
cues.zh: 每個樂手的選擇 都是一個相聯結的序列， 該序列始於有各自樂器圖片的盒子， 終於實際裝有各自樂器的盒子。

cues.text: and ends with the box actually containing it.
cues.en: and ends with the box actually containing it.
cues.zh: 該序列始於有各自樂器圖片的盒子， 終於實際裝有各自樂器的盒子。

cues.text: Note that if they kept going, that would lead them back to the start,
cues.en: Note that if they kept going, that would lead them back to the start,
cues.zh: 終於實際裝有各自樂器的盒子。 值得注意的是，繼續以此類推的話， 他們的選擇將回到最初的盒子。

cues.text: so this is a loop.
cues.en: so this is a loop.
cues.zh: 值得注意的是，繼續以此類推的話， 他們的選擇將回到最初的盒子。 所以這其實是一個迴圈。

cues.text: For example, if the boxes are arranged like so, the singer would open the first box to find the drums,
cues.en: For example, if the boxes are arranged like so, the singer would open the first box to find the drums,
cues.zh: 比如說，如果盒子是按此法擺放， 歌手會先開啟第一個盒子找到鼓， 然後開啟第八個盒子找到貝斯，

cues.text: go to the eighth box to find the bass, and find her microphone in the third box,
cues.en: go to the eighth box to find the bass, and find her microphone in the third box,
cues.zh: 歌手會先開啟第一個盒子找到鼓， 然後開啟第八個盒子找到貝斯， 然後開啟第三個盒子找到麥克風，

cues.text: which would point back to the first.
cues.en: which would point back to the first.
cues.zh: 然後開啟第三個盒子找到麥克風， 這也將指引他回到第一個盒子。

cues.text: This works much better than random guessing because by starting with the box with the picture of their instrument,
cues.en: This works much better than random guessing because by starting with the box with the picture of their instrument,
cues.zh: 這樣比隨機猜五個盒子有效多了。 因為從有他們各自樂器 圖片的盒子開始找， 每位樂手都將選擇限制在 包含他們各自樂器的迴圈裡，

cues.text: each musician restricts their search to the loop that contains their instrument,
cues.en: each musician restricts their search to the loop that contains their instrument,
cues.zh: 因為從有他們各自樂器 圖片的盒子開始找， 每位樂手都將選擇限制在 包含他們各自樂器的迴圈裡，

cues.text: and there are decent odds, about 35%, that all of the loops will be of length five or less.
cues.en: and there are decent odds, about 35%, that all of the loops will be of length five or less.
cues.zh: 並且有不錯的機率，大概有 35%， 所有這樣的迴圈只要五步或者更少。 我們如何算出這個機率的呢？

cues.text: How do we calculate those odds?
cues.en: How do we calculate those odds?
cues.zh: 我們如何算出這個機率的呢？ 為了簡便，我們舉一個簡化的例子，

cues.text: For the sake of simplicity, we'll demonstrate with a simplified case,
cues.en: For the sake of simplicity, we'll demonstrate with a simplified case,
cues.zh: 為了簡便，我們舉一個簡化的例子， 只有四種樂器， 每個樂手最多隻能開啟兩個盒子。

cues.text: four instruments and no more than two guesses allowed for each musician.
cues.en: four instruments and no more than two guesses allowed for each musician.
cues.zh: 只有四種樂器， 每個樂手最多隻能開啟兩個盒子。 我們先來看看失敗的機率，

cues.text: Let's start by finding the odds of failure, the chance that someone will need to open three or four boxes
cues.en: Let's start by finding the odds of failure, the chance that someone will need to open three or four boxes
cues.zh: 我們先來看看失敗的機率， 也就是說需要開啟三個或者四個盒子 才能猜對自己的樂器的機率。

cues.text: before they find their instrument.
cues.en: before they find their instrument.
cues.zh: 才能猜對自己的樂器的機率。 總共有六種不同的四個步驟迴圈。

cues.text: There are six distinct four-box loops.
cues.en: There are six distinct four-box loops.
cues.zh: 才能猜對自己的樂器的機率。 總共有六種不同的四個步驟迴圈。

cues.text: One fun way to count them is to make a square, put an instrument at each corner,
cues.en: One fun way to count them is to make a square, put an instrument at each corner,
cues.zh: 計算這個的一個有趣的辦法 是去畫一個方形。 把四個樂器分別擺到四個角， 然後畫出對角線。

cues.text: and draw the diagonals.
cues.en: and draw the diagonals.
cues.zh: 然後畫出對角線。 看看你究竟能找出多少獨特的迴圈，

cues.text: See how many unique loops you can find, and keep in mind that these two are considered the same,
cues.en: See how many unique loops you can find, and keep in mind that these two are considered the same,
cues.zh: 看看你究竟能找出多少獨特的迴圈， 注意這兩種迴圈其實是同一種， 只是始於不同的起點而已。

cues.text: they just start at different points.
cues.en: they just start at different points.
cues.zh: 只是始於不同的起點而已。 然而，這兩種就不相同啦。

cues.text: These two, however, are different.
cues.en: These two, however, are different.
cues.zh: 然而，這兩種就不相同啦。 我們用三角形就能觀察到 八種不同的三個步驟的迴圈。

cues.text: We can visualize the eight distinct three-box loops using triangles.
cues.en: We can visualize the eight distinct three-box loops using triangles.
cues.zh: 我們用三角形就能觀察到 八種不同的三個步驟的迴圈。 總共有四種三角形，

cues.text: You'll find four possible triangles depending on which instrument you leave out,
cues.en: You'll find four possible triangles depending on which instrument you leave out,
cues.zh: 總共有四種三角形， 取決於哪一種樂器不含在其中， 而每種三角形有兩種不同的路徑。

cues.text: and two distinct paths on each.
cues.en: and two distinct paths on each.
cues.zh: 而每種三角形有兩種不同的路徑。 所以在總共 24 種盒子的 排列組閤中，

cues.text: So of the 24 possible combinations of boxes, there are 14 that lead to faliure,
cues.en: So of the 24 possible combinations of boxes, there are 14 that lead to faliure,
cues.zh: 所以在總共 24 種盒子的 排列組閤中， 有 14 種會失敗， 還有 10 種會成功。

cues.text: and ten that result in success.
cues.en: and ten that result in success.
cues.zh: 還有 10 種會成功。 這種計算方法適用於 任何有偶數個樂手的情況，

cues.text: That computational strategy works for any even number of musicians,
cues.en: That computational strategy works for any even number of musicians,
cues.zh: 這種計算方法適用於 任何有偶數個樂手的情況， 但是如果你想要一個簡便辦法，

cues.text: but if you want a shortcut, it generalizes to a handy equation.
cues.en: but if you want a shortcut, it generalizes to a handy equation.
cues.zh: 但是如果你想要一個簡便辦法， 可以概括成一個方便的方程式。 代入 10 位樂手， 得出約 35% 的機率。

cues.text: Plug in ten musicians, and we get odds of about 35%.
cues.en: Plug in ten musicians, and we get odds of about 35%.
cues.zh: 代入 10 位樂手， 得出約 35% 的機率。 如果有 1,000 位樂手呢？

cues.text: What if there were 1,000 musicians?
cues.en: What if there were 1,000 musicians?

cues.zh: 1,000,000 位呢？ 隨著 n 的增大，機率接近 30%

cues.text: As n increases, the odds approach about 30%.
cues.en: As n increases, the odds approach about 30%.
cues.zh: 隨著 n 的增大，機率接近 30% 並不能完全保證成功，

cues.text: Not a guarantee, but with a bit of musician's luck, it's far from hopeless.
cues.en: Not a guarantee, but with a bit of musician's luck, it's far from hopeless.
cues.zh: 並不能完全保證成功， 但如果樂手運氣不錯， 總不至於是毫無希望的。 如果大家喜歡這這個謎題， 就再來試試這兩個吧。

cues.text: Hi everybody, if you liked this riddle, try solving these two.
cues.en: Hi everybody, if you liked this riddle, try solving these two.
cues.zh: 如果大家喜歡這這個謎題， 就再來試試這兩個吧。
